draw: census: all 57 witnesses of census.json, in order
transcript: proposal_canon.json is produced by canonically serialising the proposal artifact with recursive key-sorting at every object level and no whitespace anywhere in the output; a third party re-derives hProposal by running sha256sum on proposal_canon.json and confirming it equals the stated hProposal, then re-derives seedHex by concatenating hProposal with the published salt (hProposal + salt, as raw hex strings) and computing sha256 over that concatenation, and since mode is census with N=57, the draw rule requires no further sampling — the witness set is simply every entry of census.json taken in order, all 57 of them.
